name: HRP-5P
summary: A prototype construction humanoid from Japan's AIST, built with high-power, wide-range joints so it can do heavy building work: it autonomously picks up a sheet of drywall, holds it against studs and drives screws with a power tool. Aimed at labour shortages in construction, shipbuilding and aircraft assembly.
notable: High-power electric joints for heavy labour

sources.title: AIST — Development of a Humanoid Robot Prototype, HRP-5P, Capable of Heavy Labor
